purpose: Synthetic offline conformance inputs. They contain no live token, tenant, user, device, station, issuer key, or credential.

harness.crypto: RS256 JWT signatures using ephemeral test key pairs generated by node:crypto

cases.assertion: A signature-valid canonical human token for tenant A matches an active, exact online membership readback for tenant A.
A valid canonical human token and active readback for tenant B cannot authorize a Doorstar operation resolved to tenant A.
active=false readback denies an otherwise signature-valid token.
Changed permissions or membership/projection version in readback denies; it is not intersected or silently replaced.
A token iat lower than accept_tokens_issued_at_or_after is denied before exp.
The old key remains valid only while its exact kid remains in the overlapping JWKS.
The new key is independently selected by its exact kid during overlap.
An old token is denied after a fresh JWKS view removes its kid; verification-key cache freshness is bounded to 300 seconds and no all-keys signature fallback exists.
The post-rotation JWKS view is evaluated after the maximum 300-second cache freshness window, so the old kid cannot remain accepted indefinitely.
A new-kid token remains valid when the retired JWKS contains only the new exact kid.
spaceos_principal_kind=service and service-principal claims cannot be interpreted as a human projection.
spaceos_principal_kind=plant_user_device and cnf/dpop_jkt/device_id/station_id/spaceos_plant_* claims are denied by the human consumer.
latest cannot select a content-addressed release.
A branch cannot select a content-addressed release.
A local build or working-tree path cannot select a content-addressed release.
